summary: Implemented the speed indicator feature in rich/progress.py, CHANGELOG.md, and tests/test_progress.py. Changes: TaskProgressColumn gained a show_speed option (default off), a static render_speed method that scales speed via filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix and returns "it/s" text, a render branch for unknown totals, and a documented Args section. The track() helper gained show_speed (default True) and passes it to the column. Progress.track no longer raises for unsized iterables with no total; the total stays None. A CHANGELOG line was added under Unreleased / Added. Tests: added test_task_progress_column_speed, and removed the ValueError assertions from test_track and test_progress_track. Nothing was run, per instructions, and nothing was committed. render_speed is a staticmethod, which satisfies the class-level callable requirement.
